chunks: And to Midian, their brother Shu'aib. He said: 'O my people, worship God, for you have no other god but Him. Clear proof has come to you from your Lord; so give in full measure and full weight, and do not keep back from people what is theirs, and do not corrupt the land after it has been reformed. That is best for you if you are believers.'

key_terms.شُعَيْباً: Shu'aib, a prophet sent to the people of Midian
key_terms.مَدْيَنَ: Midian, the city/region where Prophet Shu'aib was sent

ai.seo_question: What were the main messages of Prophet Shu'aib to the people of Midian regarding faith and trade?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Shu'aib as the 'Qutb' (Pole) of the Midianites, linking his call for monotheism directly to social justice and economic integrity. The emphasis on 'awfa al-kayl wa al-mizan' (fulfilling the measure and weight) is often interpreted not merely as commercial fairness but as a divine mandate for equitable distribution of wealth, reflecting the Shia concept of 'Adl (Justice). This narrative serves as a foundational precedent for the Imamate's role in establishing both spiritual and socio-economic order.
